title: Caulked joints.
officialText:
Joints for hub and spigot pipe shall be firmly packed with oakum or hemp. Molten lead shall be poured in
one operation to a depth of not less than 1 inch (25 mm). The lead shall not recede more than 0.125 inch (3.2 mm) below the rim
of the hub and shall be caulked tight. Paint, varnish or other coatings shall not be permitted on the jointing material until after the
joint has been tested and approved. Lead shall be run in one pouring and shall be caulked tight. Acid-resistant rope and acidproof
cement shall be permitted.
